record_audits.database_measure: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals 60% similar to AP2007. Mol formula: C67H121N15O19S1; Mol Wt: 1485.852; GRAVY: 1.21; Activity: Active against Gram+ bacteria B. thuringensis AB92037, B. subtilis AB91021, S. aureus AB94004 (MIC 25 ug/ml) and M. luteus AB93113 (MIC 12.5 ug/ml), but inactive against Gram- bacteria E.coli AB94012, P.aeruginosa AB93066, or fungi C.albicans AY93025 at a concentration of 100 ug/mL. Structure: CD: helical in 30% or 70% TFE.
